name: holdout5
seeds: Hi! I'm Ramon Villanueva, Mon to everyone. Born November 2, 1984 in Iloilo City. My wife Liza and I have two kids, Gabriel and Bea, and we live in Antipolo.
Liza and I got married on 16 April 2011 in Marikina. My college barkada Arnel Cruz was our best man, and he's still my closest friend after all these years.
Si Gabriel ay ipinanganak noong Setyembre 21, 2012. Si Bea naman, ika-8 ng Pebrero 2016. Grade 8 na si Gab ngayon, si Bea Grade 5.
My father, Tatay Ernesto Villanueva, passed away in Iloilo on June 3, 2023. His mother, Lola Pilar, went ahead of him in 2019.

My older sister Joy is a nurse in Dubai. She moved there from Riyadh in 2021 and married Dennis, a Filipino engineer she met there, in 2023. I also have a half-brother, Paolo, Tatay's son from his first marriage. Paolo owns a sari-sari store in Pototan.

seeds.text:
Subject: She's here!!

Kuya Mon, our baby girl Amara Grace arrived on 14 March 2026, 4:10 am, 3.1 kg. Dennis cried more than I did. Please tell Nanay, I'll video call tonight.

Love, Joy

seeds: Nanay Cora remarried last January, to Tito Rudy Manalo, a retired seaman. Rudy has a daughter, Trisha, so I guess she's my stepsister now. Nanay and Rudy live in Jaro, Iloilo City.
My mother-in-law Fely lives in Tanay with Liza's brother Carlo Ocampo. And Arnel's son Migo is my godson. I plan to buy him a bike for Christmas.
Neighbours: Aling Nena next door has watched our kids since they were babies, and Kuya Jerome across the street always lends us his ladder.

Career so far: BS Electrical Engineering at Mapúa, 2001 to 2006. Junior engineer at Luzon Power Systems 2006–2014, then senior electrical engineer at Pacific Grid Solutions from July 2014 until I resigned in January 2024. My boss there was Engr. Victor Lim, VP for operations. I still have lunch with my old colleague Mylene Garcia, who's now head of procurement at Pacific Grid.

seeds.text: 5 Feb 2024. Today my business partner Glenn Torres and I registered VoltaPinas Engineering Services with the SEC. I hold 60%, Glenn 40%, and I'm president. Ate Joy lent me ₱200,000 for my share of the capital. Kinakabahan pero excited!

seeds: VoltaPinas rents a small office in Cubao since March 2024, ₱28K a month. We hired Kat Reyes as project engineer in March 2025; she reports to me.

Our biggest client is Rizal Cold Storage Corp. We signed the warehouse retrofit contract with them on March 2, 2026, worth ₱4.2M. Handover is due on 30 September 2026. Dong Abad's crew does our cable pulling as subcontractor.
Good news: Rizal Cold Storage paid us the second tranche on Aug 12, ₱1,260,000. The retrofit has been in full swing since April, and the new panel boards were energized July 20.

I've been an IIEE member since 2007, and I joined a paluwagan with my old Pacific Grid friends, ₱5,000 every 15th. My PRC license expires on November 2, 2027. These days I pay myself ₱140,000 a month from VoltaPinas; Liza teaches science at Antipolo National High School and earns around ₱42k a month.

seeds.text:
DEED OF ABSOLUTE SALE
Vendor: Teresita Gomez
Vendees: Spouses Ramon P. Villanueva and Liza O. Villanueva
Property: house and lot, Blk 7 Lot 22, Mayamot, Antipolo City, 180 sq.m., covered by TCT No. 045-2015009871
Consideration: Three Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos (₱3,850,000.00)
Signed this 20th day of October 2015 in Antipolo City.

seeds: I lived in my condo in Mandaluyong until November 2015, then we moved to Antipolo. I'd bought that condo in 2010 for ₱1.6M, and we finally sold it to Henry Chua on May 9, 2026 for ₱2,900,000.
Our family car is a silver Toyota Innova, plate NDA 4127. Bought it brand new in August 2019 from Toyota Marikina for ₱1,450,000.

seeds.text:
From: Bayanihan General Insurance <renewals@bayanihangen.ph>
To: Ramon Villanueva

Dear Mr. Villanueva,
Your Innova insurance policy no. BGI-MV-0098812 (Toyota Innova, NDA 4127) is due for renewal on 30 September 2026. Renewal premium: PHP 32,480.00.
Thank you for staying with Bayanihan.

seeds: Note to self: passport expires March 9, 2027, so renew it before we go to Dubai. Driver's license is valid until Nov 2, 2028. We're planning to visit Joy and baby Amara in Dubai in April 2027.

From Tatay we inherited his riceland in Pototan, 1.2 hectares, Lot 4471. Joy and I co-own it. Mang Celso has been the tenant farmer there for twenty years. Since April I've been planning a solar water pump for it, after the harvest, but it's only on paper so far.
VoltaPinas bought a Mitsubishi L300 van in October 2024 for ₱1.1M, plate CAB 9183. And the bank appraised the Antipolo house at ₱6.5M in February 2026.

Paid Ate Joy the last ₱50,000 on 20 December 2025, so the ₱200k loan is fully settled. She sends Nanay ₱15,000 every month from Dubai. For the record, Pacific Grid released my final pay in February 2024: ₱310,000.
August payments so far: ₱6,000 to Teacher Abby for Bea's math tutoring, Php 3,500 to Dr. Lorna Santos for Gabriel's braces, and ₱20,000 as our gift for my cousin Kristine's wedding on August 8.

Big project: we're adding a second floor to the Antipolo house, two bedrooms and a bathroom so Nanay and Fely can stay with us. Been planning the extension since October 2025. Architect Rhea Mendoza drew the plans; I paid her ₱45,000 design fee on November 10, 2025.
Mang Tonyo (Antonio Dela Paz), our foreman, quoted ₱1,350,000 for labor and materials. Our total budget for the extension is ₱1.5M.

Building permit for the extension was released Dec 18, 2025. Tonyo's crew started on January 12, 2026 and I gave him P400k downpayment that same day. Joy chipped in ₱100,000 in February for Nanay's room.

seeds.text: 28 March 2026. Second-floor slab poured today! Tonyo's men worked past 9pm. Paid him the second tranche, ₱350,000. Gabriel helped carry hollow blocks all afternoon. Proud of him.

seeds: Ugh. The extension has been on hold since May 4: steel prices jumped and the rains came early. Budget is now ₱1.8M, not ₱1.5M. Liza is choosing the tiles and fixtures.

Back on track! Tonyo's crew resumed on June 15. Paid Tonyo ₱300,000 on June 30, and Php 38,500 to Boyet the plumber on July 22 for the bathroom rough-in. Roofing was finished 7/31. Tonyo promised turnover by November 30.

Napagdesisyunan na namin ni Joy ngayong Agosto: tuloy na ang solar water pump sa Pototan. Ang quote ng SunHarvest Solar ay ₱185,000, at nagbayad na ako ng ₱50,000 na downpayment noong Agosto 10. Ang installation ay naka-schedule sa Setyembre 15.
Trips: Hong Kong with the family Dec 26–30, 2025, Bea's first time at Disneyland. Then home to Iloilo in January 2026 for Dinagyang and to visit Tatay's grave.
Gabriel has an orthodontist appointment with Dr. Lorna Santos on August 28 at 9am. By the way, how much have I paid Mang Tonyo so far?
Dr. Santos' clinic texted: Gabriel's orthodontist appointment is moved to September 4, same time.
Had my annual physical at St. Luke's on July 10, all fine except my cholesterol. When does the Innova insurance renew again?
Correction on the Innova: we bought it in July 2019, not August. I checked the OR/CR.

seeds.text: 1 January 2026. Ten-year vision: VoltaPinas becomes the go-to solar installer in Western Visayas. This year: hire five more engineers. Open an Iloilo branch by 2028. Move Nanay into the new room once the extension is done. Someday Liza and I will retire to the Pototan riceland and build a small bahay kubo there.

seeds: Decisions this week: we will NOT sell the Pototan riceland, even though a developer offered ₱4M. Liza and I also decided to start a college fund for the kids, ₱10,000 a month starting September. Glenn and I decided VoltaPinas will bid for the Iloilo Business Park maintenance contract. Next year I want to buy a second car, probably a Vios, and Liza plans to start her master's at PNU in 2027.
